newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banorte says to raise 1 bln pesos by Sept.
newsitem.headline: Banorte says to raise 1 bln pesos by Sept.

text.p: The Banorte financial group plans to complete its one billion peso capital raising process by September 30, the group's director general told journalists on Wednesday.
"(The) commitment to raise one billion pesos in capital which will be fulfilled by September 30 at the latest," Banorte Director General Othon Ruiz said.

The bank is required to raise the funds as part of an agreement with government bank insurance fund Fobaproa. Ruiz did not say how the capital will be raised, but it would not make any debt placements.

Ruiz added that the capital raised would enable Banorte to acquire Banpais. The smaller bank was part of the Asemex-Banpais financial group until Fobaproa intervened last August when mismanagement in the bank was discovered.
